item.title: Two Boulder County wildfires were sparked by downed Xcel lines, fire districts say
item.description: Two wildfires that sparked in December, one of which prompted hundreds in the Boulder County foothills to evacuate, were caused by Xcel Energy lines that were blown down amid strong winds when the utility re-energized without first checking them, according to leaders of two area fire districts.

item.description: It is becoming evident the 2025-26 Colorado men’s basketball team might be the worst rebounding club in 16 seasons under head coach Tad Boyle.

item.title: Great American Beer Fest to move outdoors
item.description: Unlike wine connoisseurs, beer drinkers typically don’t let their brews breathe after they crack open a can. But the organizers of one of the craft beer industry’s biggest annual events have decided that a little fresh air is just what they need to breathe some new life into the Great American Beer Festival.
